Step.SQLStatement: -- Declares the volatility of the read-only PL/pgSQL functions of the ADempiere schema. -- -- By default PostgreSQL treats every function as VOLATILE, which prevents the planner from flattening -- views that call them (e.g. RV_Payment paymentAllocated/paymentAvailable, RV_C_InvoiceLine -- productAttribute, RV_C_Invoice charAt), from filtering/limiting before joining, and from skipping -- columns nobody selects. These functions only read data (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, sequences, random -- values or clock functions, directly or through the functions they call), so they can be STABLE; -- charAt is a pure SUBSTR and can be IMMUTABLE. -- -- Functions that write, use sequences or randomness (nextID*, getMaxTableID, getUUID, alterColumn, -- deps_*, add_missing_translations) and extension (C) functions are intentionally left untouched. -- -- Idempotent and safe to re-run; functions missing in a database are skipped. Only catalog metadata -- changes (no data).
